conditions.noise_target: independent zero-mean Gaussian error in observed cube X and Y only; apply the same X/Y offsets to observation entries CubeXYZ[0:2] (indices 3,4) and RelativeXYZ[0:2] (indices 6,7); do not change indices 0:3, 5, 8:12; no clipping

environment.success_rule: existing criterion: lift >=0.10m sustained for >=5 control steps

evaluation.outputs: separate files in bc_results/h4_observation_noise/; append-safe partial CSVs, strict row/schema/seed/hash validation, exclusive study lock, no overwrite

hypotheses: Noise may reduce, preserve, or increase the R4−R1 success gap; no direction is assumed.
The noise interaction may vary across BC training seeds.
R1 and R4 are compared on shared initial positions and a coupled, step-indexed XY noise schedule.
integrity_checks: Checkpoint SHA against the prior H4 report and training provenance before/after evaluation.
At sigma=0, R1/R4 outcomes, step timing, inference counts, close/lift timing, and terminal chunk index match saved previous H4 replanning Final rows on seeds 310000–310019.
R4 sigma=0 actions/chunk indices on saved trace seed 290042 match within 1e-7.
Only policy observations at indices 3,4,6,7 are perturbed; true environment state/physics/termination unchanged.
Per-episode base noise digest matches across R1/R4 and all sigma levels; applied-noise digest matches R1/R4 at each sigma.
Each of 18 Final files has exactly 1,000 ordered, unique seeds 321000–321999; all paired positions match exactly.
Paired beneficial/harmful arithmetic and model hashes verified.
No old or previous H4 result files overwritten.

noise.algorithm: For each episode, initialize numpy.random.Generator(PCG64(SeedSequence([noise_generation_seed, evaluation_seed]))); draw standard_normal((161,2)) as float32 once. Array row t is the absolute environment control-step t XY standard-normal pair, independent of policy inference calls. Multiply the same base array by sigma in meters for applied errors. R1/R4 and all sigma levels therefore share the same base noise at each (evaluation_seed, control_step).

primary: Gap(seed,sigma)=Success(R4,sigma)−Success(R1,sigma) for each BC seed and each sigma.
secondary: success degradation from sigma=0 for each interval

policy.training_or_updates: none; no BC/SAC training, parameter updates, reward changes, SAC, or learned gate

research_questions.RQ1: Does R4 retain its success-rate advantage over R1 under noisy object-position observations?
research_questions.RQ2: Does increased observation noise change the performance difference between frequent feedback and temporally consistent open-loop execution?
research_questions.RQ3: Are the effects consistent across the three frozen BC training seeds?

statistics.bootstrap: 10,000 paired percentile bootstrap resamples of the 1,000 evaluation seeds; resample a seed index jointly across all six interval×noise outcomes within each BC model. Fixed bootstrap RNG seed 20261107. Report 95% CIs for Gap and NoiseInteraction contrasts.
statistics.exact_tests: Exact two-sided McNemar for R4 vs R1 within each sigma; Holm correction across the three BC seeds separately at each sigma. Exact McNemar for each noisy-vs-clean comparison within the same model and interval; Holm correction across all 12 noisy-vs-clean tests.
statistics.regional: Exploratory EN/ES/WN/WS summaries and transition counts, no confirmatory claim.
statistics.seed_level: Report all three model-specific results, directional consistency, and descriptive mean/median/sample SD/range across only three trained BC seeds; no population-level superiority claim.
statistics.timing: Inference latency and episode wall time descriptive due sequential hardware-load sensitivity.
statistics.unit: evaluation seed/initial position paired within each frozen model; do not treat positions as independent trained policies

stopping_conditions: Stop and preserve outputs on any duplicate seed, schema/hash/position mismatch, concurrent writer lock, or checkpoint mutation.
Do not change noise levels, noise generation seed, control conditions, success rule, or evaluation seeds after Final outcomes are inspected.
study: Observation Noise Robustness of Frozen H4 Replanning Policies
